description: This file implements USB device interface management functions for the Zephyr RTOS, including endpoint operations, interface modification, shutdown, default configuration, and setting interface alternate settings.

methods.name: handle_ep_op
methods.description: Handles enabling, disabling, or testing a USB endpoint based on the specified operation.

methods.name: usbd_interface_modify
methods.description: Modifies the endpoints of a specified interface, enabling or disabling them based on the operation.

methods.name: usbd_interface_shutdown
methods.description: Disables all endpoints associated with the device's interfaces, effectively shutting down the interface.

methods.name: usbd_interface_default
methods.description: Sets all interfaces to their default alternate setting based on the device configuration.

methods.name: usbd_interface_set
methods.description: Sets a specific interface to a given alternate setting, modifying endpoints accordingly.
